weekend_note: Dry and mild all weekend: highs 77 to 81, lows in the mid 50s and rain chances around 2 to 3 percent, so nearly everything is outdoors-friendly. Picks: free Opera After Dark on Friday, SevilleStock/Hippie Fest and the Glass & Ceramic Pumpkin Patch on Saturday, Hunter Hayes at the Interstate Fair, Boo at the Zoo, and the Ice Flyers at the Bay Center (indoors, Saturday night). Storm recovery is still under way, so double-check smaller events before heading out.

news.title: Escambia eases contractor licensing rules after Isaias
news.summary: Re-roofing work is temporarily open to more contractors, including some from outside the county, through December unless the order is rescinded. Officials warn about unlicensed storm-chasers and say red flags include big upfront payments.

coverage_note: Written overnight Thursday into Friday, Oct 23. Weather: Fox Weather supplied daily highs, lows and rain chances for Oct 23 to 29 (Oct 24's rain chance was not listed, so 2 percent is an estimate in line with neighbors); the National Weather Service forecast, updated Oct 22 afternoon, runs 1 to 2 degrees cooler on Saturday. Oct 30 uses Weather Underground temperatures with an estimated rain chance, and its table hints at some rain near Halloween. Events come from Local Pulse's weekend list, Visit Pensacola, Beachguide and carried-over earlier checks. Must Do Pensacola, the downtown calendar, PensacolaBeach.com, Allevents, NorthEscambia.com's events page and the Saenger/Blue Wahoos sites could not be opened this run, so the north Escambia and Gonzalez items (Cantonment, Barrineau Park, Gonzalez church trunk-or-treat) and several others are carried over and not reconfirmed. No restaurant openings were confirmed. Some news links point to a publisher's front page because the individual story could not be opened; their summaries stick to the headline. The fair's Oct 30 act is Colt Ford in the official lineup but LOCASH in one local calendar.
